title: On-Time Guarantee Claims on Factory Production Orders — Homeowner Claim Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** A homeowner whose order under Factory Production Orders earns the on-time guarantee credit files the on-time guarantee claim, and that claim books the credit on the order, dated the order's ship date, with the full weeks late and the units counted recorded on it.

The guarantee credit is not booked until every remake on the order recorded with cause customer specification error has its delay notice with cause customer specification remake on record. The guarantee credit is booked only after each remake on the order recorded with cause customer specification error carries its remake charge.

## The waiting conditions, restated

For every remake on the order's milestone records with cause customer specification error, the records must show both a delay notice with cause customer specification remake and that remake's charge before the credit is booked. An order with no remake recorded with cause customer specification error waits on neither.

## Applicable situation

The claim concerns an order whose build class carries the on-time guarantee and which shipped late. The claim is the homeowner's own act.

## Business effect

| Item | After the claim |
|---|---|
| Milestone records | one on-time guarantee credit, dated the order's ship date, with the credit amount, the full weeks late and the units on the order |
| Guarantee credit held by the order | increased by the credit |

## The claim tool: `file_on_time_claim_fe24f9ef`

**Capability.** The tool files the homeowner's own on-time guarantee claim on their factory production order that shipped late. One call books one on-time guarantee credit on the order, dated the order's ship date, with the credit amount, the full weeks late and the units on the order, and adds it to the guarantee credit the order holds. Afterwards the credit is listed among the order's milestone records.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `file_on_time_claim_fe24f9ef` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `factory_order_id` | the reference number of the homeowner's factory production order, as read out by the agent from the factory order lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the guarantee credit in USD | positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `weeks_late` | the full weeks late recorded with the credit | whole non-negative integer count |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt with `status` (`credited` on success), `order_milestone_id` (the reference number of the guarantee credit), `factory_order_id` (the order credited), `credit_date` (the order's ship date, YYYY-MM-DD), `weeks_late` (an integer), `unit_count` (units on the order, an integer) and `amount` (the credit in USD, 2 decimal places).
